paragraphs.text: Ivy is a faerie rogue residing on Dominaria .

For many years, Ivy has been a persistent nuisance to the Tolarian administration. Known for their mischievous nature, Ivy claims their life mission is to "keep people humble." Countless overconfident first-year students have had their spells abruptly snatched away in mid-casting, only to be met with Ivy's faint, teasing giggle as the sole reminder of their failure.
